description: This Java class provides utility methods for executing Retrofit Call objects, handling success responses, and converting IOExceptions into runtime exceptions. It simplifies making HTTP calls and processing responses within the Fineract client library.

classes.name: Calls
classes.description: Utility class with static methods for executing Retrofit Call objects, handling success responses, and exception handling.

methods.name: ok
methods.description: Executes a Call expecting a successful response and returns the response body.

methods.name: okR
methods.description: Executes a Call expecting success and returns the full Response object.

methods.name: executeU
methods.description: Executes a Call and maps IOExceptions to CallFailedRuntimeException, returning the Response.
